popup.title: Street of Lances
popup.description: Street of Lances was walked by broadcryers who peddled their broadsheets to passers-by.

popup.title: Seawind Alley
popup.description: Seawind Alley was an alley notable for the ghostly voices that could be heard within the alley.

popup.title: Ghostwalk
popup.description: Ghostwalk was considered sufficiently safe for the rich inhabitants of the ward to walk by undisturbed. Like other alleys in the Sea Ward, it was clean and wide. It contained numerous shadowtops that were favored by children to climb and play by.

popup.title: Westwall Street
popup.description: Westwall Street was located in the western section of Waterdeep's Sea Ward, fully spanning the entire western boundary of the ward with the exterior wall in that portion of the city.

popup.title: Heroes' Walk
popup.description: Every year during the summer, Heroes' Garden and Heroes' Walk were both overtaken by the nobles of the Church of Siamorphe on their holy day, the Divine Pageantry.

popup.title: Trollkill Street
popup.description: Trollkill Street was a large road in the city of Waterdeep, spanning nearly the whole northern portion of the Trollwall, that started in the Sea Ward and ended in the North Ward.

popup.title: Street of the Singing Dolphin
popup.description: The Street of the Singing Dolphin was located in the western section of Waterdeep's Sea Ward. The road spanned the entire western side of the ward

popup.title: Oar Alley
popup.description: A minor avenue of hard-packed earth and [[gravel]] that extended off of [[Ship Street]] and terminated in a dead end.

popup.title: Tsarnen Alley
popup.description: Tsarnen Alley was a short, hard-packed dirt and gravel paved, alleyway. It was frequently walked down by pilgrims and priests on their way to the [[Plinth]].

popup.title: Tornsar Alley
popup.description: Tornsar Alley was a small side alley.

popup.title: Juth Alley
popup.description: Juth Alley was a small side alley.

popup.title: Ghemmer's Alley
popup.description: Ghemmer's Alley was a small backalley.

popup.title: Tuckpurse Alley
popup.description: Tuckpurse Alley was an alleyway of hard-packed dirt and gravel.

popup.title: Gaustus Street
popup.description:
Gaustus Street was a street of hard-packed dirt and gravel.

This street stretched from north to south, curving off of the [[Wall Way]] and terminating at the [[Court of the White Bull]].

popup.title: Walltower Walk
popup.description: Walltower Walk was a street of hard-packed dirt and gravel.

popup.title: Urcandle Alley
popup.description: Urcandle Alley was a short alleyway of hard-packed dirt and gravel. Urcandle Alley was home to one of the greatest concentrations of wheelwright stores in Waterdeep.

popup.title: Sprangalar's Swordcut
popup.description: Sprangalar's Swordcut, which was also simply called the Swordcut, was a small alley.

popup.title: Roads' End
popup.description: The tomb was used as a communal burial site for travelers who perished while visiting the City of Splendors.

popup.title: Marching Grounds
popup.description: A well protected training camp of the City Guard.

popup.title: Belzer's Walk
popup.description: An alleyway that stood on the boundary line of the [[Waterdeep/Southern Ward|Southern Ward]] and [[Waterdeep/Trades Ward|Trades Ward]].
